items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: They played all like Scott Joplin and those guys, y'know. They played all ragtime.

ctx.x: How about...did you run into any local jazz bands or musicians in any of these travels that...

No, they wasn't playin'...they called it ragtime in those days. All the piano players was ragtime piano players, y'know. They played all like Scott Joplin and those guys, y'know. They played all ragtime. Strictly ragtime.
Was there anybody--any ragtime players that really stood out in your memory? Anbody who was exceptionally good that you ran across in your travels?
